latest_release.name: Release v0.67.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Changelog for v0.65.0 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29853
* chore(release): bump version to 0.67.0-nightly.20261020.gb041de017 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29854
* Changelog for v0.66.0-preview.0 by @gemini-cli-robot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29852
* feat(cli): bridge the IDE companion into container sandboxes over exec stdio by @elberthc-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29858
* fix(core): prevent duplicate agent loading when workspace is home directory (#27692) by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29847
* fix(ide): exclude IDE settings and GEMINI.md files from open file con text by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29848
* fix(core): scope untrusted flag checks to external output and remember approved flags by @luisfelipe-alt in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29833
* fix(a2a-server): mount express.json() before A2A SDK route registration by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29850
* fix(core): adhere to RFC 9110 token rules when splitting custom headers by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29865
* fix(core): respect read-only files and hard links in atomic writeTextFile by @elberthc-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29749
* fix(a2a-server,core): preserve extended token usage metadata and align per-turn reporting by @jvargassanchez-dot in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29834
* fix(core): ensure all model turns with function calls receive thought signatures by @amelidev in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29828
* fix(cli): handle termination signals and prevent tool execution after cancellation in non-interactive mode by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29849
* fix(cli): preserve ${VAR} placeholders during deprecated settings migration by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29867
* fix(cli): stop continuation stream processing and auto-nudge after request cancellation by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29868
* fix(cli): correct Thai and Lao SARA AM display width by @elberthc-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29883
* fix(core): resolve relative file paths against active IDE workspace root by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29838
* feat(cli): add models command and --list-models flag for model discovery by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29880
* fix(cli): convert Claude hook timeout from seconds to milliseconds during migration by @villahernandez-coder in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29899
* fix(core): classify project spending cap errors as terminal quota errors by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29961
* fix(acp): include MCP server and tool metadata in permission requests by @duvanka-prasad in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29910
* fix(cli): prevent parent command name insertion on /chat list autocomplete by @urielefrenvirtusa in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29967
* fix(cli): validate finite numbers in numeric settings editor by @diegogodinezr in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29968
* fix(core): allow trusted system paths on Android (Termux) for ripgrep resolution (#21836) by @amelidev in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29884
* fix(core): normalize CRLF line endings before diffing in getDiffContextSnippet by @jesussamuel-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/pull/29966
* fix(cli): handle terminals that render ambiguous-width characters as wide by @elberthc-byte in https://github.com/google-gemini/gemin

# Gemini CLI

[![Gemini CLI CI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Gemini CLI E2E (Chained)](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/actions/workflows/chained_e2e.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/actions/workflows/chained_e2e.yml)
[![Version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@google/gemini-cli)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@google/gemini-cli)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/google-gemini/gemini-cli)](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/blob/main/LICENSE)
[![View Code Wiki](https://assets.codewiki.google/readme-badge/static.svg)](https://codewiki.google/github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli?utm_source=badge&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli)

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Read before installing — Gemini CLI status & tool guide**
>
> - **Enterprise Code Assist only:** Designed for **Gemini Code Assist Standard / Enterprise** licenses and **Code Assist for GitHub** on Google Cloud (your access remains unchanged).
> - **No free tier or Google AI plans:** Free individual access and **Google AI Pro / Ultra** (Google One) moved to [Antigravity CLI](https://antigravity.google/product/antigravity-cli) on June 18, 2026 ([transition post](https://developers.googleblog.com/an-important-update-transitioning-gemini-cli-to-antigravity-cli/)).
> - **Not optimized for Gemini 4+:** Not tuned for the **Gemini 4** series (for example, [Gemini 4 Argon](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/gemini-4-argon/)) or future releases in this or later generations.
> - **Not for model benchmarks:** Don't use Gemini CLI to benchmark Gemini models—its harness isn't tuned for Gemini 4+ and produces unrepresentative scores.
>
> **Which Google CLI do you need?**
>
> | Tool | Best for | Links |
> | :--- | :--- | :--- |
> | **[Antigravity CLI](https://antigravity.google/product/antigravity-cli)** (`agy`) | Interactive multi-agent coding terminal. Use for **Gemini 4 Argon**+, free / **Google AI Pro & Ultra** accounts, or Google Cloud. | [Download](https://antigravity.google/download) · [Migrate](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/gcli-migration) · [Argon post](https://antigravity.google/blog/gemini-4-argon-in-google-antigravity) |
> | **[Gemini API CLI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-api-cli)** (`gemini-api`) | Stateless API CLI *(not a coding harness)*. Gives agents (`agy`, Claude Code, Codex), scripts, and CI direct commands for Gemini models, media gen, file analysis, and managed agents. | [GitHub](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-api-cli) · [Releases](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-api-cli/releases) · [API docs](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs) |
> | **Gemini CLI** (`gemini`, *this repo*) | Organizations with **Gemini Code Assist Standard / Enterprise** or **Code Assist for GitHub** on Google Cloud *(
